name: Ravindra Chat Forms
author: ravistm26

sections.description:
Ravindra Chat Forms is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to easily embed WhatsApp-enabled forms on your website using a shortcode. This plugin is designed for website owners who want to collect user information through forms and instantly receive the submitted data directly on WhatsApp.
With this plugin, you can create a form using any third-party form builder platform that supports sharing form responses via WhatsApp. Once your form is ready, you can simply embed it on any page, post, or widget area of your WordPress website using a shortcode provided by the plugin. No complex coding or technical setup is required.
This makes it extremely useful for businesses that want faster communication with their customers. Instead of relying only on email notifications, you can receive inquiries, booking details, service requests, or customer messages instantly on your WhatsApp number. This helps improve response time and increases conversion rates.

Key Features:

Easy integration with WordPress using a simple shortcode
Compatible with third-party form builders that support WhatsApp data sharing
No coding skills required
Fast and direct form submission to WhatsApp
Ideal for inquiries, bookings, leads, and customer support
Lightweight and easy to use

Whether you run a small business website, service-based company, eCommerce store, or personal blog, Ravindra Chat Forms makes it simple to connect your website visitors directly to your WhatsApp for real-time communication.

This plugin helps you turn website visitors into direct conversations, making your communication process faster, smoother, and more efficient.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ravindra-chat-forms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use Ravindra Chat Forms screen to configure the link.
  4. Use the [ravindra_chat_forms] shortcode in your posts or pages.
  5. Optional: You can set custom height and width, e.g., [ravindra_chat_forms height="1000" width="100%"].
